sentences.en: There's an old saying, the best things in life are illegal, immoral, or fattening.
sentences.zh: 有一句老话，生活里最好的东西要么是非法的，要么是不道德的，要么是让人发胖的。

sentences.en: There's another way to think about this.
Many things that give us pleasure, sex, food, adventure, they contain risks.
sentences.zh: 许多带给我们快乐的事物——性、食物、冒险，都包含风险。

sentences.en: As a smart species, we've come up with ways to minimize those risks.
sentences.zh: 作为一个聪明的物种，我们想出了将这些风险降到最低的方法。

sentences.en: Condoms, seatbelts, drugs to lower cholesterol.
sentences.zh: 安全套、安全带、降低胆固醇的药物。

sentences.en: But something interesting happens as we do this.
sentences.zh: 但当我们这样做时，有趣的事情发生了。

sentences.en: As we move the risk-benefit calculation for each activity
sentences.zh: 随着我们将每项活动的风险收益权衡

sentences.en: away from the risk end of the spectrum to the benefit end of the spectrum,
sentences.zh: 从频谱的风险端转移到收益端，

sentences.en: we imagine people will become safer.
sentences.zh: 我们想象人们会变得更加安全。

sentences.en: Seatbelts, for example, will keep drivers from getting hurt.
sentences.zh: 例如，安全带将防止司机受伤。

sentences.en: Now that would be true if people kept doing things exactly the way they did before.
sentences.zh: 如果人们继续完全按照以前的方式行事，那确实如此。

sentences.en: But some people make another calculation.
sentences.zh: 但有些人做出了另一种权衡。

sentences.en: If putting seatbelts in cars means you are likely to survive a crash,
sentences.zh: 如果在车里装上安全带意味着你更有可能在车祸中幸存，

sentences.en: there's now a temptation to go faster.
sentences.zh: 那么现在就会产生开快车的诱惑。

sentences.en: An ocean swimmer might go out a little further when a lifeguard is nearby.
sentences.zh: 当救生员在附近时，海滨游泳者可能会游得更远一点。

sentences.en: Football players who know their heads are protected by helmets might start to hit a little harder.
sentences.zh: 知道自己的头部受到头盔保护的橄榄球运动员可能会开始撞得更猛烈一点。

sentences.en: This phenomenon has a curious name.
sentences.zh: 这种现象有一个奇怪的名字。
经济学家称之为道德风险。

sentences.en: It's a bit of a misnomer because moral hazard has little to do with morality.
sentences.zh: 这个词有点名不副实，因为道德风险与道德几乎没有什么关系。

sentences.en: It's about what happens when you move the risk-benefit calculation to make things safer
sentences.zh: 它是关于当你改变风险收益权衡以使事情变得更安全时

sentences.en: and people respond by taking more risks.
sentences.zh: 人们通过承担更多风险来做出反应的情况。

sentences.en: So there's a paper a while back by Sam Peltzman

sentences.en: that kind of lays out the classic case of moral hazard that economists like to point to.

sentences.en: This is economist Jennifer Doliak at Texas A&M University.

sentences.en: And his idea was that when seatbelts first became required in cars,

sentences.en: if you have a seatbelt, maybe you drive a little bit more recklessly.
sentences.zh: 如果你系了安全带，也许你开车会更鲁莽一点。

sentences.en: Sam Peltzman found that while drivers were safer because of seatbelts,
sentences.zh: 山姆·佩尔茨曼发现，虽然司机因为安全带而更加安全，
但他们开车也更加鲁莽。
这把行人置于危险之中。

sentences.en: He argued that the safety benefits of seatbelts were cancelled out when you took this into account.
sentences.zh: 他认为，当你把这一点考虑进去时，安全带的安全益处就被抵消了。

sentences.en: Now, subsequent studies have challenged this finding.
sentences.zh: 现在，随后的研究对这一发现提出了质疑。

sentences.en: But the seatbelt example illustrates the dilemma posed by moral hazard.
sentences.zh: 但安全带的例子说明了道德风险带来的困境。

sentences.en: Should you make things safer if people are just going to take more risks?

sentences.en: Or should you allow people to face the consequences of their actions
